title: Bounded reachability closure
statement: Given an oracle $\mathrm{orc}:\mathrm{Fin}(4)\to\mathrm{List}(\mathrm{Bool})\to\mathrm{Bool}$, a Boolean input list $x$, and natural numbers $r,K,v$, define the bounded reachability predicate to hold when there is some $u<K$ such that the initial predicate at $u$ is true and $v$ is reachable from $u$ by finitely many steps, each step satisfying the step predicate and ending at a value below $K$.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle from indices in $\mathrm{Fin}(4)$ and Boolean lists to Boolean answers
